name: Getting Started with Rust (LFEL1002)
certifications: Getting Started with Rust digital badge
requirements: Enrol for free and finish the 60 to 90 minute course within the 30 days of access.
verificationNote: Course page lists "$0 Course only", "Digital Badge", "60-90 Minutes of Course Material" and "30 Days of Access to Online Course".
notes: An introduction, not a proficiency exam. The Linux Foundation's own announcement also mentions a certificate of completion; the course page names only the badge.
why: The Linux Foundation's own course page states the price as $0 and lists a digital badge. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Coddy Rust Certification
certifications: Coddy Rust certificate (one per section of the Rust journey)
requirements: Finish every lesson and challenge in a section of the Rust journey; the certificate is generated automatically.
verificationNote: Certification page: "every certificate on Coddy is 100% free to earn, view, download, and share. There is no hidden paywall or subscription required" and each has "a unique ID and a public URL".
notes: Coddy is a small interactive-course platform; the certificate shows completion, and no employer recognition is claimed.
why: The provider's own page says the certificate is free and verifiable, but the issuer is a small platform nobody else vouches for. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Angular Basics free course
certifications: SkillUp course completion certificate: Angular Basics
requirements: Enrol on SkillUp and complete the 3 hours of video lessons within the 90 days of access.
verificationNote: Course page lists a "Completion Certificate", "3 Hours Of self-paced video lessons" and "90 Days of Access"; its FAQ says "There are no hidden fees associated with the free course."
notes: A completion certificate, not an accredited certification. Simplilearn uses SkillUp to advertise its paid programmes.
why: Simplilearn's own page states the course and its completion certificate are free with no hidden fees. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: Applied Skills: Get started with classes, properties, and methods in C#
certifications: Microsoft Applied Skills: Get started with classes, properties, and methods in C#
requirements: Sign in to Microsoft Learn and pass the interactive lab assessment. A failed attempt can be relaunched after 72 hours.
verificationNote: Microsoft Learn lists "Applied Skills: Get started with C#" on its student credentials page (updated 2026-09-18), and the credential page offers the lab assessment with a 72-hour wait between launches. Neither page states a price.
notes: The site already carries Applied Skills as one general offer; this is the C# credential on its own so it is findable under C# and .NET. The exam code is taken from the study guide link (APL0200) and should be checked.
why: The credential exists and is current on Microsoft Learn, but that it is free rests on the Applied Skills programme in general, not on a sentence on this page. Added by hand on 2026-10-03.

name: ASP.NET Core free course with certificate
